title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E14 — Fred & Carol & Fred & Donna
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E15 — A Guest In The Yard
Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E16 — The Big Party
Faced with more bills than they can pay, Fred and Lamont decide to give a neighborhood party -- and charge admission. Everything goes well until two gangsters show up and make the Sanfords 'an offer they can't refuse.'.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E17 — Lamont Goes African
Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E13 — Louise's Sister
A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E19 — Andy Williams, Jonathan Winters, Arte Johnson, Bob Hope
Andy & Flip play expectant fathers; Geraldine & Maude Frickert (Winters) are fellow travelers; Flip & Arte do a movie spoof.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E1 — David Frost, James Brown, Sundayís Child
James Brown discusses dance moves; Frost interviews Geraldine & (along with Sunday’s Child) joins Rev. Leroy’s church.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E2 — Bobby Darin, Denise Nicholas, Stanley Myron Handelman, Roy Clark
Flip & Stanley each do monologues; the cast does a taxi skit and a western parody Butch Cassidy & The Suntan Kid.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E3 — Lily Tomlin, Redd Foxx, The Temptations
Lily & Flip do saloon and computer dating bits; Redd gives an English lesson and Rev. Leroy preaches with the Temptations.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E12 — Merry Clayton/Rev. Jesse Jackson
Merry Clayton, top back-up singer who emerged a star, sings "Grandma's Hands.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E13 — Chester Himes/The Dells
Author Chester Himes is welcomed back from self-exile in Europe on this show devoted primarily to his writings. Actor Al Freeman Jr., who reads from Himes' autobiography, and The Dells, who sing several of their hits, join the welcome.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E1 — The Wild, Wild Webst
Webster fantasizes that he is a hero in the Wild West defeating a bully.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E2 — The Painting
At an art gallery, George glimpses at a truly shocking work of art: a nude portrait of Katherine in her younger days.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E3 — The Quiz Show
Webster and his classmates face some unfair competition when they're contestants on a TV quiz show.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E4 — Papa's Big Romance
George's dad Papa Papadapolis picks up a new hobby and ends up on a date with the instructor: a belly dancing teacher!

title: Webster
description:
S6 E5 — The Election
Webster runs the campaign of a class presidential candidate.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E7 — Operation: Deja View
While recovering from "twin appendectomies," Tia and Tamera go in search of hospital records that could reveal the identities of their biological parents.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E8 — Tattoo
When Lisa forbids Tia to see her boyfriend Michael, Tamera acts as a go-between for the couple -- but finds herself falling for him.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E9 — Two for the Road
Tia and Tamera take their sisterly bond a little too far when they collide with each other's cars while learning to drive.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E10 — Its A Party Thang
When the "cool crowd" doesn't invite Tia and Tamera to their "happening" party, the twins decide to throw a bash of their own -- which could wind up being a "bust"!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E11 — Field Trip
A class field trip to a museum lands the twins in detention, while Roger "borrows" a statue that makes him irresistible to women.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E18 — Model Employee
Rather than asking Frank every time she wants something, Mo decides to get a part-time job at the Class Act where Hakeem works.
